title: Health Resort office key with a blue tape

infobox.usage: Unlocks the room 110 of the East wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Health Resort office key with a blue tape (E110 San Tape) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Azure Coast sanatorium office rooms, marked with blue duct tape.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a location for the quest Chemistry Closet

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- On Sanitar
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: - The first floor, room 110 of the East Wing in the Health Resort on Shoreline.

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- 1x PC
- 1x Plastic suitcase
- Loose loot (Medical supplies, Valuables)
- Multiple LEDX spawns in the bathroom
- Possible GPU spawn on the left side of the desk
